title: Bramble Isles
engine: the snesrev/smw C reimplementation (SDL2, built with Emscripten)
description: An original 16-bit side-scroller across the Bramble Isles, built on the Super Mario World decomp.
overview: Bramble Isles runs on the snesrev/smw C reimplementation of Super Mario World, compiled to WebAssembly. Only the game code and structural facts (sizes, counts, timing, entrance and warp anchors) come from the decomp; every level, the overworld, all graphics, palettes, music, sound effects, instrument samples and text are new and generated by the clean-room pipeline. Hero TOBI rides the lizard ZEEP against KING GRUMBOLT.
engineLicense: MIT (snesrev/smw); see the upstream project and the clean-room repository
assetLicense: Original clean-room assets (new levels, art, music, sound and text); no retail data is distributed
controls: Gamepad — any standard controller, detected automatically
Touch — on-screen SNES pad on phones and tablets when no controller is connected
saveInstructions: Progress is stored by the build in this browser, under andrewnakas.github.io. Clearing site data removes it.
limitations: Levels, art, music and text are original and intentionally unlike the retail game.

verification.scope: Headless Edge on a local build: title, file select, intro, overworld and new levels with audio; static reachability check over every generated course; taint and originality gates 0 failing. Owner controller playtest pending.
